game.title: Intro Statistics: Reading the Data
game.description: Read scatter plots, histograms and summary statistics the way a statistician would: estimate, locate, and explain.

questions.prompt: Warm-up (everyone scores): estimate the correlation coefficient r for this scatter plot.
Estimate the correlation coefficient r for this scatter plot.
In a normal distribution, about what percentage of values lie within one standard deviation of the mean?
One point doesn't follow the pattern. Tap the outlier.
Tap the top edge of the bar that contains the median wait time.
Which measure of center is least affected by extreme outliers?
A correlation of r = −0.9 describes a weaker linear relationship than r = 0.5.
The middle value of an ordered data set is called the ___.
Which of these measure the spread of a data set? Select all that apply.
Which topic would you like to review next class?
